caption: The drawing is executed in black ink on a beige or light tan sheet of paper and consists of three orthographic projections: a top view, a side view, and an end view of a rectangular object with four supporting legs. The top view, placed at the upper portion of the sheet, displays a rectangular shape with slightly curved shorter sides and parallel long edges; two horizontal projections (the legs) extend beyond the shorter sides. The side view, oriented directly below the top view, depicts the object as a horizontal trapezoidal shape with legs extending downwards, one closer to each end; there is a small, irregular notch or cutout visible along the upper edge. The end view, located to the lower right of the side view, shows a symmetrical structure with a broad base, a curved lower edge, a central support or leg, and a slightly curved top edge. The drawing is bordered by a double line, contains signs of adhesive residue and minor staining, and features the author’s signature “G. Bernhardt” and a scale annotation “Scale 1/2" = 1'” at the bottom left.
title: Cradle
